mapping_notes.NO_2: TYNDP NOS1/NOS2/NOS3 ~ NO1/NO2/NO5 (inferred: NOS2 hosts the NOSF/NOWF offshore hubs, which lie in NO2)
mapping_notes.PL: Tulipa v2 virtual buses PL00E/PL00I carry no demand and are not mapped

de_lu: DE_LU is a single bidding zone in all ENTSO-E and JAO market data and is kept as ONE zone in every table (load, generation, capacity, prices, flows, net positions are DE_LU totals). Reduced network: in the DC-OPF network v11b (--zone-merge=LU:DE) the LU buses are merged into zone DE, so the reduced network's DE node covers exactly the DE_LU bidding zone. Tulipa market nodes: the baseline keeps DE00 and LUG1 as two nodes (LUG1 = Creos grid, linked by baseline NTC flows); every comparison in this script sums DE00 + LUG1. The LU country load is fetched as an auxiliary series so the input builder can split DE_LU load between DE00 and LUG1; nothing is subtracted here.
